segments.text: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind and said:
“Who is this who obscures My counsel by words without knowledge?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Now brace yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall inform Me.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Who fixed its measurements? Surely you know! Or who stretched a measuring line across it?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: On what were its foundations set, or who laid its cornerstone,
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Or who set its core in place

segments.text: while the morning stars sang together and all the sons of God shouted for joy?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Who enclosed the sea behind doors when it burst forth from the womb,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: when I made the clouds its garment and thick darkness its blanket,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: when I fixed its boundaries and set in place its bars and doors,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: and I declared: ‘You may come this far, but no farther; here your proud waves must stop’?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: In your days, have you commanded the morning or assigned the dawn its place,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: that it might spread to the ends of the earth and shake the wicked out of it?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: The earth takes shape like clay under a seal; its hills stand out like the folds of a garment.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Light is withheld from the wicked, and their upraised arm is broken.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Have you journeyed to the vents of the sea or walked in the trenches of the deep?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Have you surveyed the extent of the earth? Tell Me, if you know all this.
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Where is the way to the home of light? Do you know where darkness resides,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: so you can lead it back to its border? Do you know the paths to its home?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Surely you know, for you were already born! And the number of your days is great!
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: which I hold in reserve for times of trouble, for the day of war and battle?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: In which direction is the lightning dispersed, or the east wind scattered over the earth?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Who cuts a channel for the flood or clears a path for the thunderbolt,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: to bring rain on a barren land, on a desert where no man lives,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: to satisfy the parched wasteland and make it sprout with tender grass?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Does the rain have a father? Who has begotten the drops of dew?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: From whose womb does the ice emerge? Who gives birth to the frost from heaven,
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: when the waters become hard as stone and the surface of the deep is frozen?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Can you bind the chains of the Pleiades or loosen the belt of Orion?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Can you bring forth the constellations in their seasons or lead out the Bear and her cubs?
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Or bring forth Mazzaroth in its season

segments.text: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you set their dominion over the earth?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Can you command the clouds so that a flood of water covers you?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Can you send the lightning bolts on their way? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Who has put wisdom in the heart or given understanding to the mind?
segments.speaker: The LORD

footnotes.text: + Or Who has given the ibis wisdom, that is, wisdom about the flooding of the Nile

segments.text: Who has the wisdom to count the clouds? Or who can tilt the water jars of the heavens
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: when the dust hardens into a mass and the clods of earth stick together?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Can you hunt the prey for a lioness or satisfy the hunger of young lions
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: when they crouch in their dens and lie in wait in the thicket?
segments.speaker: The LORD

segments.text: Who provides food for the raven when its young cry out to God as they wander about for lack of food?
segments.speaker: The LORD
